review.note: A11(a), A9: the item's P276 is Q10282, Pamplona. The placement is right and is not written: the place record put a second 'Pamplona' on the map beside Natural Earth's own, and its label overlapped the tracked all-caps 'PYRENEES' that tests/map-browser.test.mjs forbids. The fix is data, not display: tools/import/naturalearth.mjs --places, which holds Pamplona at Q10282.

title: Battle of Noáin
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Noáin", at revision 1375299067, opens: "The Battle of Noáin or the Battle of Esquiroz, fought on 30 June 1521 was the only open field battle in the Spanish conquest of Iberian Navarre. It was a decisive victory for the Spanish against the Franco-Navarrese army." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2889540, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1521 battle during the Spanish conquest of Iberian Navarre". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
